Overview

Designing, explained

Good design makes a small business look established and a big business look trustworthy. Inconsistent logos, colours and graphics do the opposite.

Our Design Hub creates everything your business needs to look consistent: your logo and brand, social graphics, print materials and ad creative. You receive all source files, so your brand is always yours.

Who it's for

  • New businesses needing a brand
  • Businesses with a dated or inconsistent look
  • Teams producing lots of social and ad content
  • Businesses preparing for a launch or event

Why it matters

Why Designing matters for your business

Design is often the first thing customers notice. A consistent, professional look makes a business seem established and trustworthy, both online and in print.

Inconsistency is common as businesses grow: different fonts, colours and styles across the website, social media, signage and ads. It quietly weakens your brand.

Our Design Hub gives you one place for all your design needs, with a consistent brand applied everywhere and all source files handed over.

  4. Monthly reporting

Pricing

What affects the cost of Designing

  • How competitive your industry and keywords are
  • How many channels you want us to manage (search, ads, social, listings)
  • How much content and design you need each month
  • Your ad budget, which is always shown separately from our fee
  • Whether your website needs work before campaigns start

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Get a fixed quote

Getting started

What we'll need from you

  • Access to your website, Google Business Profile and social accounts
  • Access to Google Ads, Meta Business Manager and Google Analytics, if you have them
  • Your logo, brand colours and any photos you'd like used
  • Who your best customers are, and which products or services you want more of

Don't have all of this yet? That's fine. We'll work through it together in your free consultation.

FAQ

Designing questions

Can you refresh our existing logo?

Yes. We can modernise it while keeping what customers recognise.

Is design included in plans?

It's in the Business and All-in-One plans, or on its own as Design Hub.

How many logo options will we see?

We present a small set of distinct directions, then refine your favourite.

Do we get the original files?

Yes. You receive all source and export files.

Can you design for print?

Yes. We supply print-ready files and can liaise with your printer.

How quickly can you turn around designs?

Turnaround depends on the work. We'll agree timings in your plan.

Can you work with our existing brand?

Yes. We can follow your current guidelines or refresh them.

Do you design presentations and documents?

Yes, including proposals, presentations and branded templates.
